question: Who are our 5 most valuable customers? Give their unique customer id and the total amount they paid, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many customers ordered more than once?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1)

question: What percentage of our revenue (item prices) comes from repeat customers, meaning customers who placed more than one order?
gold_sql: WITH rep AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM rep) THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id

question: Which product category has the worst customer satisfaction, among categories with at least 100 reviews? Give the English category name and its average review score.
gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG(review_score) AS avg_score FROM (SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.review_score, t.product_category_name_english AS category FROM reviews r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = r.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name) GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY avg_score ASC LIMIT 1

question: Are late deliveries getting better or worse over time? Give the late delivery rate (percentage) for each year of purchase, for delivered orders.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS y, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN date(order_delivered_customer_date) > date(order_estimated_delivery_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY y

question: Which month had the highest revenue from item prices? Give the month as YYYY-MM and the revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS m, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY m ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 sellers have the highest freight cost relative to the price of what they sell, among sellers with at least 50 items sold? Give the seller_id and the ratio, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(freight_value) / SUM(price) AS ratio FROM order_items GROUP BY seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 5

question: Customers of which state pay the highest average freight per order? Give the state and the average freight per order.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(x.f) AS avg_freight FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(freight_value) AS f FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) x JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = x.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of orders are paid in more than one installment?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN payment_installments > 1 THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_payments

question: How many orders were paid with more than one payment method?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) > 1)

question: Which day of the week gets the most orders? Give the day as a number (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday) and the number of orders.
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%w', order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) AS dow, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY dow ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: For customers who ordered at least twice, what is the average number of days between their first and second order?
gold_sql: WITH x AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS u, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) SELECT AVG(julianday(b.t) - julianday(a.t)) FROM x a JOIN x b ON a.u = b.u AND a.rn = 1 AND b.rn = 2

question: Which 5 customer cities generate the most revenue from item prices on delivered orders? Give the city and the revenue, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_city, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: Do slow deliveries get worse reviews? For delivered orders, give the average review score for orders that took more than 20 days from purchase to delivery (label 'slow') and for the others (label 'fast').
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp) > 20 THEN 'slow' ELSE 'fast' END AS speed, AVG(r.review_score) FROM orders o JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY speed

question: What percentage of sellers have sold at least once to a customer in a different state than their own?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.seller_state <> c.customer_state THEN s.seller_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.seller_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
